name: Trikonasana
description: A foundational standing pose that stretches the hamstrings, spine, and chest while improving core stability.
benefits: Stretches legs, knees, ankles, chest, and shoulders

steps.instruction: Spread your feet three feet apart, raise arms sideways to shoulder level.
steps.voice_prompt: Stand with your feet about three feet apart, raise both arms parallel to the floor, palms facing down.

steps.instruction: Turn your right foot out ninety degrees, keeping hips square.
steps.voice_prompt: Turn your right foot outward ninety degrees, keeping your torso facing forward.

steps.instruction: Reach your torso to the right, hinging sideways at your hip.
steps.voice_prompt: Exhale, reach your torso to the right, and hinge sideways at your hip joint.

steps.instruction: Lower right hand to shin, reach left arm straight up, and gaze up.
steps.voice_prompt: Lower your right hand to your shin, extend your left arm up, and look at your left thumb.

steps.instruction: Inhale, rise back up to center, and release your arms.
steps.voice_prompt: Inhale, pull yourself up, turn your foot forward, and lower your arms.
